rationale: Describes geospatial software to document and model assets in 2D or 3D and integrate with spatial databases; conventional GIS functionality with no AI signal.
evidence_spans: Efficiently document and model assets in a 2D or 3D geospatial environment.

OpenCities Map products seamlessly and intuitively integrate with the most common spatial databases including Oracle Spatial, SQL Server Spatial, PostgreSQL (PostGIS), and Esri (FGBD, ArcGIS Server and online).
